name: Shin Won
source:
President of a in-campus music club called "Carpediem".

Because of his exceeding disinterest in women, there used to be rumors of him being gay. Although Capediem has always been a male-dominated club, ever since Shin Won took up presidency, it has transformed into all-male club that does not accept girls at all.
